en: The Recorded Sayings of Master Jing, Volume One:
Recorded Sayings from His Stay at Qingliang Temple in Jiankang Prefecture,
Compiled by Attendant Wensu.
On the fifth day of the tenth month in the third year of the Jiading era,
the Master accepted an invitation to enter Huazang Baozhong Chan Temple.
Pointing to the mountain gate, he cuts off all pathways and comes straight forward;
when heaven and earth are thoroughly penetrated, this gate opens.
On the left he claps his hands, on the right he blows the flute.
Turning the pivot upside down, wind and thunder arise;
pointing to the Buddha Hall, one opens the hall and beholds the Buddha.
